items.title: Claude Fable 5 returns with 'extraordinarily strong' safeguards after US lifts controls
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5以'异常严格'安全措施回归，美国解除出口管制
items.summary: Claude Fable 5 returned to Claude's model library on July 1 with what sources describe as extraordinarily strong safeguards — so restrictive that some observers suggest Fable 5 may functionally be Opus 4.8 behind the scenes.

items.title: 8点1氪 roundup: Anthropic accused of detecting Chinese users; Cambricon loses ¥70B in a day; OpenAI reportedly halves inference cost
items.title_zh: 8点1氪｜Anthropic被指暗藏代码检测中国用户；寒武纪一日蒸发700亿；OpenAI推理成本据报减半
items.summary: 36氪早间汇总：Anthropic回应Claude暗藏代码检测中国用户的争议；AI芯片龙头寒武纪市值一日蒸发超700亿元；OpenAI据报实现系统优化突破，模型推理成本减半。此外二手豪华燃油车价格大幅跳水。

items.title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
items.title_zh: Weave Robotics发布Isaac 1家用机器人，售价$7,999，2026年秋季交付
items.summary: Weave Robotics launched Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot targeting Fall 2026 deliveries, generating significant HN discussion (177 points, 244 comments) about the consumer robotics market.

items.title: Ex-DJI scientists' aerial-AI startup SPARO raises 4 rounds in 6 months (¥100M+)
items.title_zh: 前大疆科学家创业，硅羽科技半年内连获四轮数亿元融资
items.summary: 硅羽科技聚焦通用空中智能，由前大疆科学家团队创立，半年内连续完成四轮数亿元融资，投资方包括锦秋基金、阿里巴巴、弘毅投资等，致力于推动飞行器从遥控工具进化为能理解环境、自主决策的空中智能体。

items.title: Tencent-backed DPU chip unicorn Jaguar Micro files for ChiNext IPO seeking $422M
items.title_zh: 腾讯投资的DPU芯片独角兽Jaguar Micro冲刺创业板IPO，拟募资4.22亿美元
items.summary: Jaguar Micro, China's top independent DPU chip maker and a Tencent portfolio company, filed for ChiNext IPO to raise funds for its next-generation 800G/1.6T data processing unit products.

items.title: After spooking Trump into safety testing, Anthropic AI models get global release
items.title_zh: 在迫使特朗普进行安全测试后，Anthropic AI模型获全球发布
items.summary: After a government-ordered takedown that spooked the Trump administration into safety testing, the US lifted export controls on Anthropic's advanced Fable and Mythos models, clearing them for global release.

items.title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
items.title_zh: Weave Robotics发布Isaac 1家用机器人，售价$7,999，2026年秋季交付
items.summary: Weave Robotics launched Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot targeting Fall 2026 deliveries, generating significant HN discussion (177 points, 244 comments) about the consumer robotics market.

items.title: Oomwoo: a DIY open-source robot vacuum you build yourself
items.title_zh: Oomwoo：一款可自行组装的DIY开源扫地机器人
items.summary: Oomwoo is a fully open-source, do-it-yourself robot vacuum project that lets builders assemble their own cleaning robot, drawing 278 points and 51 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Autonomous vehicle hype is back — Humble Robotics brings it to freight
items.title_zh: 自动驾驶热潮回归——Humble Robotics将自动驾驶引入货运领域
items.summary: The autonomous vehicle space is experiencing a repeat of the 2016 hype cycle with Travis Kalanick back in robotics and capital pouring back in, as freight-focused Humble Robotics positions itself at the center of the renewed momentum.

items.title: Gemini Spark — Google's agentic assistant — is now available on Mac
items.title_zh: Google智能体助手Gemini Spark现已登陆Mac
items.summary: Google's 24/7 agentic assistant Gemini Spark launched on Mac alongside improvements including real-time tracking and expanded third-party app support.

items.title: LLMs are stuck in a groupthink groove — this startup is trying to get them out
items.title_zh: 大模型陷入群体思维困境——一家初创公司正试图打破这一局面
items.summary: MIT Technology Review reports that LLMs consistently exhibit groupthink when prompted for diverse opinions — for example, almost always returning 7 as a random number — and profiles a startup working to increase output diversity in language models.

items.title: Google on Android Halo, talking less about AI, and Gemini's car camera integration
items.title_zh: Google谈论Android Halo、减少AI话题比重、以及Gemini车载摄像头整合
items.summary: Android head Sameer Samat discussed Android 17 upgrades, a strategy to emphasize practical features over AI buzzwords, and Gemini's upcoming use of car cameras in Android Automotive in a Google for Developers video.

items.title: Tsinghua silicon photonics startup SmartCore raises angel++ for optical I/O chiplets
items.title_zh: 清华系硅光子企业灵动芯光完成天使++轮融资，推进光I/O芯粒研发
items.summary: 清华系硅光子公司灵动芯光完成数千万元天使++轮融资，由磐霖资本领投，资金将聚焦芯片间光互联核心技术，重点推进SmartComb多波长密波光源及SmartPHY光I/O小芯粒的产品化落地。

items.title: Tsinghua-founded Physical-AI startup secures ¥100M seed: we don't want the world-model label
items.title_zh: 清华系Physical AI初创完成数亿元种子轮：我们不想被贴上世界模型的标签
items.summary: 清华博导李一鸣创立的Physical AI初创公司完成数亿元种子轮融资，创始人曾任英伟达视觉AI团队负责人，强调公司聚焦解决物理世界完整系统问题而非单纯走世界模型技术路线。

items.title: Beihang robotics spinoff raises ¥100M angel round for smart variable-stiffness joints
items.title_zh: 北航机器人所团队创业，智能变刚度关节公司完成近亿元天使轮
items.summary: 航墨科技完成近亿元天使轮融资，公司源自北航机器人所重点研发项目，首创智能变刚度关节模组FlexmoJoint，面向人形机器人与消费级智能外骨骼市场。

items.title: Tsinghua + CAS team with West China Hospital develop elderly-care transfer robot
items.title_zh: 清华、中科院团队联合华西医院研发康养转运机器人，布局居家养老
items.summary: 深圳可立点科技完成战略融资，由力合科创领投，公司聚焦AI+机器人养老场景，已推出与川大华西医院联合研发的康复助行转运机器人及居家主动陪伴机器人，均已完成工程样机开发。

items.title: Meitu CEO: making AI products is a game you can't pre-plan
items.title_zh: 美图CEO吴欣鸿：做AI产品是一场难以提前策划的游戏
items.summary: 美图CEO吴欣鸿接受专访，2025年美图收入38.58亿元、净利润9.65亿元（同比增64.7%），AI重构的影像与设计产品收入占比从35%升至76%，海外MAU重回1亿，AI视频编辑工具Wink在东南亚南美增长迅速。

items.title: PKU quantum team raises funding led by GL Ventures — first nK neutral-atom quantum computer in China
items.title_zh: 北大博士量子团队获高瓴创投领投，国内首家nK中性原子量子计算机工程化
items.summary: 纳开量子完成首轮数千万元融资，由高瓴创投领投。公司源自北京大学量子电子所CAP课题组，是国内首家聚焦超冷原子量子模拟计算与中性原子通用量子计算路线的公司，已斩获千万级市场订单。

items.title: allenai/olmocr
items.title_zh: allenai/olmocr — AI2的PDF线性化工具包，用于大模型训练数据准备
items.summary: olmocr from Allen Institute for AI is a toolkit for linearizing PDFs into formats suitable for LLM datasets and training pipelines.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.title_zh: facebook/astryx — Meta开源智能体就绪设计系统
items.summary: Astryx is Meta's open-source design system that is fully customizable and built to be agent-ready for AI-assisted UI development workflows.

items.title: 0xNyk/council-of-high-intelligence
items.title_zh: council-of-high-intelligence — 18个AI人格的多轮结构化商议
items.summary: Council of High Intelligence orchestrates 18 AI personas — Aristotle, Feynman, Kahneman, Torvalds and more — in structured multi-round deliberation across multiple LLM providers for decision-making.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.title_zh: usestrix/strix — 开源AI安全渗透测试工具
items.summary: Strix is an open-source AI penetration-testing tool designed to find and fix application vulnerabilities through automated security analysis.

items.title: Measuring the Gap Between Human and LLM Research Ideas
items.title_zh: 衡量人类与大模型研究创意之间的差距
items.summary: This paper builds a large-scale evaluation framework to quantitatively measure how far current LLM-generated research ideas are from those of human researchers, going beyond single-dimension novelty/feasibility scoring.

items.title: GPU-Parallel Linearization Error Bounds for Robust Optimal Control of Nonlinear Systems
items.title_zh: 面向非线性系统鲁棒最优控制的GPU并行线性化误差边界
items.summary: This paper develops tight, differentiable, GPU-parallel linearization error bounds for real-time robust optimal control of uncertain nonlinear and neural-network dynamical systems.

items.title: Theoria: Rewrite-Acceptability Verification over Informal Reasoning States
items.title_zh: Theoria：基于非形式推理状态的重写可接受性验证
items.summary: Theoria presents a verification framework that bridges the gap between formal proof assistants (high certainty, low coverage) and scalar LLM judges (high coverage, opaque), enabling auditable verification over informal reasoning states.

items.title: World from Motion: Generative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Video
items.title_zh: World from Motion：从单目视频进行生成式动态高斯重建
items.summary: World from Motion conditions a video diffusion model on dense, pixel-aligned renderings encoding appearance, geometry, and 3D scene motion to generate freely renderable dynamic 3D Gaussian representations from monocular videos.
